name: DCS Input Command Injector (Quaggles)
summary: Hook mod that lets you add custom input commands from your Saved Games folder instead of editing each aircraft's game files.
description: Lets you add custom keybinds to any module by putting command files in `Saved Games\DCS\InputCommands`. Release 1.0.14 replaces `Scripts\Input\Data.lua` in the DCS install folder; Hardpoint backs up the original and can re-apply the mod after a DCS update.

releases.changelog: Updated for DCS 2.9.26.23111.1 Data.lua changes; strongly recommended, older versions can leave the controls page in a bugged state.
